evidence: The reactor pressure was kept at 5 Torr through the ALD process. The ALD was conducted at temperatures between 100 and 400 /C14 C. The Hf(NMe 2)4 vapor and O 2, as an oxidant, were sequentially injected into the reactor twice for 3 s each time, while the reactor was purged with Ar for 9 s between the two injections.
